findings.claim: A single valid WTerm write producing more than 2,048 responses silently loses replies because draining happens only after all WasmBridge chunks complete.
findings.evidence: Built WTerm plus committed PR WASM received 2,049 CPR queries (8,196 bytes) in one write and emitted only 2,048 onData callbacks.
findings.layer: end-to-end Zig producer through built WTerm callback
findings.path: WTerm.write → WasmBridge.writeRaw chunks → Terminal.enqueueResponse drop-newest → WTerm._drainResponses

findings.claim: The DOM drain-loop fix has no regression test that fails when the fix is reverted.
findings.evidence: The changed DOM test supplies one response only; origin/main's pre-fix WTerm delivered the same one response while a two-response force-red drive left response-b queued.
findings.layer: WTerm delivery contract and regression-test sensitivity

findings.claim: The API reference still says getResponse clears the buffer although it now dequeues only one pending response.
